conventions.origin: floor centre (characters: between the feet) unless noted

models.notes: Male survivor, light kurta-like shirt (Quaternius Peasant outfit, colour A), black side-parted hair, medium-brown skin. Skinned to a 65-bone humanoid skeleton (bone names root, pelvis, spine_01..03, neck_01, Head, clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand_l|r, fingers, thigh/calf/foot/ball_l|r). Animations are Quaternius Universal Animation Library 1+2 clips retargeted onto THIS character's rest pose (world-space rotation delta + scaled pelvis translation), baked at 30 fps, in place (no root motion). Each GLB carries its own clips; clips from one survivor GLB should not be applied to a different body type (male vs female rest poses differ). One mesh node with materials Outfit/Skin/Hair/Eyes (one draw call each). Torch in IdleFlashlight is held in the left hand (bone hand_l). "Downed" is a 1 s static hold of the lying pose (first frame of GetUp/LayToIdle); no crawl clip exists in the free UAL packs. Load with GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder.
models.heightNote: rest-pose (T-pose) height incl. hair; origin at the feet

Shikari "Chowkidar" - roaming main hunter (replaces monster.glb). ~2.3 m, emaciated ash-grey body with dark veins, hunched (spine offset baked into every clip), arms to the knees, long black claws, lips sewn shut with wire, pale small deep-set eyes (material MonsterEyes, emissive), torn khaki watchman uniform, belt + whistle cord. Extra bone "jaw" (child of Head): rotate it about its LOCAL +X axis to open the mouth (e.g. jaw.rotateX(0.66) = 38 deg; the Scream clip does this). Node "Lantern" (brass hurricane lantern mesh) is parented to bone hand_l; its child node "LanternFlame" holds the glass (alpha-blended, faint red-orange emissive) + flame mesh - add the red PointLight as a child of LanternFlame. Clips are UAL zombie/human clips retargeted to this body; Scream is procedural (head thrown back, jaw open, arms out).

models.notes: Chudail - haveli area monster. ~1.85 m, very thin grey-white woman, long thin fingers with dark nails, BACKWARDS feet (rotated 180 deg, ankles twisted), silver payal (anklets with bells) on both ankles, torn off-white saree (skirt to mid-calf so the feet show, maroon zari border at the hem, diagonal pallu across the chest + pallu tail down the back) and a torn maroon blouse. Very long wet black hair (alpha-masked hair cards, material Hair, alphaMode MASK) covers the face completely and hangs below the waist; faint pale eyes (MonsterEyes) can glint through. Idle = slow side-to-side sway with tilted head; Walk = slowed walk (gliding under the saree); Run = forward-leaning lunge; CrouchIdle = huddled, head down, sobbing shake (crying woman); Scream = head thrown back, arms out (no jaw - hidden by hair).

models.notes: Andha Mareez - asylum area monster, blind, hunts by sound. ~1.95 m heavy-set, sickly pale bruised skin, filthy feet, stained hospital gown (top + skirt to the knees), thick bandage soaked in blood wrapped over the eyes (no eyeballs), torn straitjacket sleeves with dangling leather straps + iron buckles, iron shackle on the RIGHT ankle with a short chain lying on the floor. Extra bone "jaw" (child of Head): rotate about its LOCAL +X axis to open (Scream does this). CrouchIdle = rocking back and forth with head down; Listen = head cocked toward a sound; Idle includes a slow listening head sweep.

Black cat ~0.45 m long (tail up 0.35 m), emissive yellow-green eyes (material CatEyes). Root node "Cat" carries the scale/rotation. Idle/Walk from the source pack; Run, Jump (crouch-pounce-land, in place) and Hiss (arched back, puffed tail, tremble) are procedural.

Desi-looking rooster ~0.55 m, photo-textured. Clips Idle, Walk, Run (sped-up walk), Crow, Peck, Death from the source; Flutter is a procedural startled hop + shake. The source rig has NO wing bones, so there is no real wing-flap.
